recommendation.architecture: H-W hybrid. P1-P6 = design C's C2 on the Map page: text first, then a Band 13 picture, MESH only with verified units, the echo-top raster, and a two-hour loop. PG = a link-only three.js globe (design D with these grafts), built only after P1-P4 pass and OW-1 approves a library and JS caps. No nav item; Now and Storm reports cards unchanged.
why: Scores: rules D 7, C 6; engineering C 8, D 6; product C 5.4, D 4.5; owner-ask O: D 7, C 3. C leads two lenses; the globe is gated, not dropped.
C2 adds no library (Leaflet vendored, 147,552 B raw). D adds 417,073 B gzip and about 850 JS lines (judge2-engineering K13).
Loop: D's 12-frame MRMS loop is about 10 MB per visit (K7); C2's 12 class frames are at most 0.9 MB (design-c P4). Both need persistence (build.py:472-478; K8).
Honesty: lifted tops and volumes make parallax error (parallax.json:8-9) read as position and severity (judge2-product). Gated by OW-16 and OW-20.
Schedule: median gap 151.5 min (computed). Freshness claims stay conditional until P0 passes, for C2 and PG alike.
recommendation.not_recommended: Design D first (rules top score): fastest globe, but its loop, JS and unmeasured 11-level frame are the largest open costs (judge2-engineering K7, K9, K13). A: CDN Cesium breaks AGENTS.md:71-72. B: second server and installers; needs D27 reversed.
recommendation.gap: C2 gives no globe, rotation, true-height clouds or 3D volumes (design-c.json). Only PG meets the literal ask, after its gates.

scores.method: Judge scores as recorded; ranks within a lens; not quality claims about any provider, library or model (AGENTS rule 9).

decisions_to_write.title: Radar stale past 30 minutes
decisions_to_write.proposed: Correct 15 to 30 min (gridded.py:53; sources.py:115; DESIGN.md:333). fresh_seconds 1800 for the MRMS keys.

decisions_to_write.title: Storm layers off by default
decisions_to_write.proposed: Statewide products over the frame box (gridded.py:38) behind build flag --storm-layers (proposed; default off). The default build writes no storm files or strings. No place-derived file leaves the build (D24, D27). Four nav items stay.

decisions_to_write.title: Satellite kinds and labels
decisions_to_write.proposed: satellite_image (observation): 'Satellite picture (GOES Band 13, observation)'. satellite_estimate: 'Estimated cloud-top height. Top only; cloud base not observed.' Never 'measured'. MRMS stays a radar estimate, labelled modified (rights-matrix.json lines 5, 10, 22; wording unverified). MESH: 'Estimated hail (not observed hail size; not damage)' only after units are verified. Add a kind field to every CONTRACTS entry (sources.py:45-138 has none).

decisions_to_write.title: Freshness per product
decisions_to_write.proposed: fresh_seconds / unavailable_seconds from source valid time: MRMS 1800 / 10800 (gridded.py:53-54); GOES ACHA and Band 13 1200 / 3600 (goes-aws.json: ACHAC median upload 114.8 s; C13 30.2 s); stations 4500 (sources.py:34); alerts each build; page 1500 (base.html:57); GIBS 3600 / 10800 only if used (gibs.json); terrain version-stamped. A unit test fails on any missing value.

decisions_to_write.title: Vendored browser code
decisions_to_write.proposed: Third-party code and fonts under website/static/vendor/ at an exact version, with LICENSE and vendor.lock.json (name, version, licence, source, date, sha256). Build fails on mismatch. Versions need 14 days of age (design-b). No CDN, ion or paid key (AGENTS.md:71-72). First entry: Leaflet 1.9.4.

decisions_to_write.title: Browser duties and caps
decisions_to_write.proposed: Browser JavaScript is limited to js_duties (E1-E8; N1-N6; G1-G12 and V1 only if OW-1 approves). The page-age check is the only freshness clock for new layers. Caps as in js_duties.budgets. 'Missing is not dry' (DESIGN.md:275-276) gains 'Blank is not clear' for radar and cloud layers.

decisions_to_write.title: Publishing terms (site-wide)
decisions_to_write.proposed: NOAA-derived products have been on Actions and Pages since D28. The quoted terms limit Actions to developing and testing and bar CDN use. Counsel reads them before any new NOAA-derived product is published (OW-10). If not cleared, product files move to object storage (hosting-options.json; R2 10 GB free; not re-fetched).

decisions_to_write.title: Correction: Folium does not bundle Leaflet
decisions_to_write.proposed: Folium loads Leaflet from jsDelivr with no integrity attribute (folium.py:27; cited by the supervisor and two designs; not re-read here). The website serves its own Leaflet 1.9.4 (D27).

decisions_to_write.title: Invented data labelled, never live
decisions_to_write.proposed: Invented layers carry the SAMPLE label on every page, legend and export (base.html:16-18; gridded.py:101-109; build.py:270) until OW-12 decides. --require-live fails if sample text reaches _site (new test).

decisions_to_write.title: Evaluation gate for new feeds
decisions_to_write.proposed: No new MRMS level, MESH or GOES feed reaches main until OW-21 approves evaluation-predeclared.json. Fidelity passes only at zero mismatches; comprehension passes at 0.90 with n >= 20, otherwise report-only (lines 19-23, 64). SPC reports are not treated as ground truth for radar (line 67).

decisions_to_write.title: Product contract and refusals
decisions_to_write.proposed: Sidecars carry schema, last_run_utc, source_valid_utc, next_expected_utc, max_age_min, bytes and sha256. A product step never raises; one failure leaves other pages written (test). An unknown map.json version is refused ('needs a newer build'). A malformed product is refused and the last verified frame stays with its age.

dissent.design_b: Strongest route security (16 route tests); bundling meets rule 4. Prefer B only if D27 is reversed. Not recommended.
